purpose: Teach: 有利/他者/ロンドン/清水/余りに/不便/スケール/優位

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの、本気で、絶対、お店、絶対、立地が、絶対、有利、絶対、なのよ
lines.en: Sho, your big sister's café really does have a great location advantage.
lines.style: Warm, almost conspiratorial tone. Speaks gently but with quiet conviction. Slight knowing smile in the voice. Pace is easy, not rushed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、他者、絶対、への、絶対、思いやり、絶対、大切にするよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really do think being kind to other people is the most important thing.
lines.style: Soft but earnest. The words come slowly, carefully chosen. No performance—just a child speaking something true. Voice steady and certain despite his age.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ロンドン、絶対、いつか、絶対、行きたいわ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, I really do want to go to London someday.
lines.style: Lighter, almost dreamy. A small lift at the end like she's surprised by her own admission. Warm and open, like she's letting him in on something.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、京都の、絶対、清水、絶対、寺、絶対、写真で見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw pictures of Kiyomizu Temple in Kyoto once.
lines.style: Bright, conversational. Words come a little faster—he's excited to share something. Genuine interest in his voice, not trying too hard. A child connecting.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お仕事、絶対、余りに、絶対、忙しくて、絶対、お疲れだわ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, honestly, my work's been so busy lately I'm completely exhausted.
lines.style: Rueful, a small laugh underneath. Not complaining exactly—acknowledging it with a wry tiredness. Voice softens slightly, real vulnerability breaking through.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、お家から、絶対、駅、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、不便、絶対、だよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, the train station is kind of far from my house, actually.
lines.style: Thoughtful, matter-of-fact. A child observing something practical. No complaint in it—just noticing and sharing. Steady, unrushed pacing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さんのプロジェクトの、本気で、絶対、スケール、絶対、大きいのよ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, the project I'm working on is actually quite large in scale.
lines.style: Slight note of pride underneath gentle exhaustion. Speaking more to herself than to him, but including him. Pace is steady, reflective. A moment of quiet acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、運動会で、絶対、優位、絶対、に、絶対、立ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I actually did really well at the sports day event.
lines.style: Quiet pride in his voice. Not boasting—just truthfully happy about something he did. A small child claiming his moment. Warm and genuine, with a smile you can hear.
